description: Liquid Glass Dynamic Island for Windows with media controls, system diagnostics, calendar, alarms, notes, clipboard shelf, and app launcher.
notes: The upstream installer.iss confirms Inno Setup and defines Dlives.exe as the application executable installed at the {app} root. Scoop uses Inno Setup extraction rather than running the vendor installer.
The GitHub release tag is v1.0.0. The embedded application and installer file version metadata currently reports 1.0.0.1; the Scoop version follows the release tag for checkver consistency.
